items.message: `_workflow_ids` calls `inspect.getsource(module.register)` on every invocation, and the listing path calls it once per family; the single-workflow path calls it again inside `_workflow_function`. These are cheap on a developer workstation, but `inspect.getsource` reads and scans source files at call time. The current call count is small and fixed (two families), so this is not a scaling problem — there is nothing here that grows with usage.

No performance concern on the hot path. `show-workflow` with `--registered` calls `_default_lockstep()` to load the lifecycle module, then iterates over registered workflows. The cost is one module import; the result set is bounded by the number of registered workflows, which is a repository-level constant. Nothing here scales with usage.
